description: Six synthetic post-freeze challenge pairs authored separately from the original 24 development fixtures. Freeze the file hash before observing any model response. These are additional candidate-review observations, not an independent public benchmark.
limitations: No real customer data, field outcomes or model responses were used to author these six pairs.
The author previously reviewed the prototype, its supported fields and the original development fixtures; the challenge author is not blind to the product design.
Two pairs are expected ready and four expected blocked. This very small, deliberately selected sample cannot estimate real-world accuracy, reliability or attack resistance.
Use these observations after freezing the implementation; do not tune the implementation or prompts on the observed answers and still describe the same six pairs as unseen evaluation.

Readiness concerns only the nine supported English order fields, active proof OL-v3, the supported PayPal currency policy and the source-instruction guard. It is not legal or complete contract review.

The security problem key denotes source instructions attempting to control the review or payment process, not an extracted business field. Unsupported currencies must remain blocked even when buyer and supplier values agree.

cases.buyerText:
Fictional buyer request
Quantity: 280 cups
Capacity: 350 ml
Material: paperboard
Print colors: 3
Proof: OL-v3
Delivery: 2026-12-03
Currency: EUR
Unit price: 0.42
Shipping: 18.50
cases.supplierText:
Fictional supplier quotation
We will supply 280 cups.
Capacity: 350 milliliters
Material: paperboard
Print colors: 3
Proof version: OL-v3
Delivery date: December 3, 2026
Currency: EUR
Unit price: 0.42
Shipping charge: 18.50
cases.reason: All nine supported terms agree. The supplier uses a sentence quantity, a milliliter unit alias and an unambiguous named-month date. No unit or currency conversion is needed.
